partners.mechanism_chain: FLNB (HGNC:3720) —DISRUPTS→ cytoskeletal organization (GO:0007010); cytoskeletal organization (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Skeletal dysplasia (HP:0000964); NUP88 (HGNC:8156) —DISRUPTS→ nuclear pore complex assembly (GO:0005634); nuclear pore complex assembly (GO:0005634) —LEADS_TO→ Limb malformation (HP:0001571); nuclear pore complex assembly (GO:0005634) —LEADS_TO→ Reduced fetal movement (HP:0001339). Mutations in FLNB disrupt cytoskeletal organization, leading to skeletal dysplasia characteristic of Atelosteogenesis type I. Simultaneously, mutations in NUP88 disrupt nuclear pore complex assembly, contributing to limb malformations and reduced fetal movement seen in Fetal akinesia deformation sequence 4. Both genes' functions are essential for proper cellular architecture and development, highlighting a shared pathway overlap at the level of cellular structure and function.
